title: Help & contact
label: Here to help
description: Questions about your account, Premium, or a trip you’re planning? Check the quick answers below, or send me a note and I’ll get back to you by email.

items.question: I forgot my password
items.answer: Tap Forgot password on the sign-in page and enter the email you use for your account. I’ll send a reset link that works for one hour. If you usually sign in with Google or X, use that button instead — there’s no password to reset.

items.question: How do I cancel Premium?
items.answer: Open My Journey, go to Settings, and tap Manage membership. You can switch plans or cancel there, and you keep Premium through the end of the time you’ve already paid for.

items.question: Where are my saved trips?
items.answer: Sign in and open My Journey. Trips you save from Plan a trip live under My trips, and the hotels and stories you bookmark are under Saved.

items.question: How do I change my email?
items.answer: In My Journey, open Profile and enter the new address under Name, photo, and email. I’ll send a confirmation link to the new inbox, and the change happens once you click it.

items.question: How soon will I hear back?
items.answer: Usually within a couple of days. You’ll get an email copy of your message right away — just reply to it to add anything. If you’re signed in, you can also follow your messages under My Journey → Help.

form.heading: Still need a hand?
form.intro: Send me a note and I’ll reply by email, usually within a couple of days.
form.successCopy: Opening your email app to send…

emailAside.title: Prefer email?
emailAside.body: Reach me at {email}. I read every message — replies usually take a couple of days, a little longer if I’m mid-itinerary.
